answer: The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own inlet record, and its own share of the lagoon quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The vine ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 950 identities would post 2319 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
